name: Polymerase Proofreading-Related Polyposis

criteria.description: Presence of pathogenic germline mutation in POLE or POLD1 genes affecting proofreading domains
Development of multiple colorectal adenomatous polyps, typically >10 polyps
Family history of colorectal polyposis or early-onset colorectal cancer consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Lack of mismatch repair deficiency or microsatellite instability in tumor tissue

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Pathogenic germline POLE or POLD1 mutation plus multiple colorectal adenomatous polyps
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires genetic confirmation; clinical presentation overlaps with other polyposis syndromes.

laboratory: Anemia due to chronic gastrointestinal bleeding
Normal mismatch repair protein expression in tumor tissue
imaging: CT or MRI showing colorectal tumors or polyps
other: Histopathology showing adenomatous polyps without mismatch repair deficiency

distinguishingFeatures: APC gene mutation instead of POLE/POLD1
Typically hundreds to thousands of polyps
Mismatch repair gene mutations (MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, PMS2)

redFlags: Multiple colorectal adenomatous polyps diagnosed before age 50
Family history of early-onset colorectal cancer or polyposis
Presence of pathogenic POLE or POLD1 germline mutation
references: Palles C, et al. Germline mutations affecting the proofreading domains of POLE and POLD1 predispose to colorectal adenomas and carcinomas. Nat Genet. 2013.
Jasperson KW, et al. Hereditary and familial colon cancer. Gastroenterology. 2010.
